Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
Edited: trimming, filtering, fades and peak normalization. air, blast and success are original procedural designs.

Combat refresh: tools/render_combat_audio.py makes original filtered blast and
flame-loop layers. The shot family layers the existing CC0 Kenney heavy impact
takes with original air-pressure and transient synthesis. No bit reduction or
hard clipping is applied. Source and output are included in this repository.
